- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.

- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.

## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing game. The earlier conversation identifies its intended inspiration as a 2D mobile “lordz.io” game; the current implementation is titled Realm Rush — Crownfall.

## Requirements
- Build a complete, playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kept the existing Realm Rush game and improved its controls and usability rather than replacing it.
- Added manual camera scouting with minimap dragging, right-click panning, keyboard movement, and a return-to-army camera control.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game and recovered the original request from `.omgithub/conversation.json`.
- Added minimap scouting/dragging, a CENTER button, camera follow toggle, right-click canvas panning, and mouse-wheel zoom.
- Added recruitment hotkeys `1–3`, order hotkeys `A`/`G`, camera hotkey `F`, and updated the controls text.
- Disabled recruitment cards when unaffordable, at army capacity, or not in an active game.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Finish the game build and test interaction and presentation in a browser.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot verification has not succeeded. `playwright-cli` default browser expected missing `chromium-1243`; custom config attempt failed with `ENOENT` for `/tmp/opencode/playwright-config.json,/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` changes for behavioral regressions, especially keyboard controls and pointer interactions.
2. Retry browser testing using an available Chromium configuration or another installed browser; save and inspect only the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix issues discovered, rerun syntax/diff checks, then briefly report assumptions and controls.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: game logic and new control behavior.
- `index.html`: updated minimap and control hints.
- `style.css`: styling for CENTER button, focus states, and disabled recruitment cards.
- `.omgithub/conversation.json`: records the earlier “Make an exact copy of lordz.io (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)” request.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; working tree contains edits to `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css`.
- A Python HTTP server was started for testing at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli` custom config was written to `/tmp/opencode/playwright-config.json`, but the CLI appended another config path and failed.
